notes.title: Game balance adjustments　2024/06/28
notes.content:
Game balance adjustments

- There was a bug where an event that resets your progress would occur when you got a game over.

We fixed this in the last patch so that it would not happen, and we'll make it a feature from this version onwards.

This has made the game more difficult.

- Changed the algorithm for placing events (bombs).

To reduce the element of luck, the first square is always set to "0".

Also, if you have not taken any damage, you can return to stage selection without initializing your data by selecting "Return to Title" from the menu.

- Details of the algorithm for placing events (bombs)

In the previous version, the part that was automatically generated is now created so that one path from the start to the goal is created, and events (bombs) are not placed on that path.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by making so many changes so soon after release.
